description: This Java class implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering cached sub-content within the OFBiz framework. It manages content retrieval, rendering, and editing link generation for content objects in a web application.

classes.name: RenderSubContentCacheTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class for rendering cached sub-content in OFBiz, handling content retrieval, rendering, and edit link generation.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a custom Writer that manages content rendering and editing link generation within the Freemarker environment.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Handles the actual rendering of the content, including optional edit wrapping.

methods.name: openEditWrap
methods.description: Outputs an HTML div with the specified edit style to wrap editable content.

methods.name: closeEditWrap
methods.description: Generates an edit link with parameters based on content context and outputs it within the wrapper.

methods.name: getEditStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS style for the edit link, defaulting to a property or 'buttontext'.
